note: Ghana: nationals of the ECOWAS states, Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger enter without a visa; nationals of the African Union's other states, the Caribbean states listed and Singapore need a free Electronic Travel Authorization (90 days); everyone else applies for an e-Visa (since 25 May 2026; USD 260 single entry). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Ghana Immigration Service's own eVisa guide: visa-free entry for the ECOWAS and AES nationals, an Electronic Travel Authorisation for all African nationals and the countries with bilateral visa waivers (not named), and the eVisa for everyone else; the waiver countries outside Africa and the 90 days stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Ghana
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries can visit Ghana without a visa: All ECOWAS member states Burkina Faso Mali Niger ... Citizens of the following countries and territories are required to obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization to enter Ghana, for a stay up to the duration listed below. The Electronic Travel Authorization is granted free of charge: 90 days All other African Union member states Antigua and Barbuda Bahamas Barbados Dominica Grenada Guyana Jamaica Saint Lucia Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Singapore Trinidad and Tobago ... Ghana has brought online the official portal that will be used for electronic visa applications starting May 25, 2026.

sources.title: Ghana Immigration Service, eVisa Applicant Guide, 2 Check Your Eligibility Before Applying
sources.said: Ghana's eVisa process distinguishes between visa-free entry, Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) eligibility and eVisa requirements. ... Visa-Free The traveller is eligible to enter Ghana without obtaining a visa, subject to applicable entry conditions. Check the current visa-free list and applicable passport category. See: ECOWAS & AES Nationals ETA The traveller is eligible for an Electronic Travel Authorisation. Follow the ETA process displayed by the official portal. See: All African Nationals and countries with bilateral visa waivers eVisa The traveller requires a Ghana eVisa.

sources.title: Ghana Immigration Service, Emergency Entry Visa
sources.said: ECOWAS member states and other selected countries in Africa are exempted from obtaining a visa but may be granted entry subject to prescribed conditions.
